title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes & version bump
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: Bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates auth/retry primitives, fixes several streaming edge-cases, and performs coordinated version bumps across SDK packages. What changed (high level): consolidated shared auth middleware and retry/backoff behavior into a common design; introduced consistent streaming iterator APIs and helper builders; patched race condition in TS streaming reconnect; added compatibility shims for existing customers; bumped package versions to 2.4.x to reflect API ergonomics changes. Scope: redwood-sdk-python, redwood-sdk-typescript, redwood-sdk-go, docs (changelog + migration guide), CI matrix updates. Testing: unit tests and integration tests added for streaming reconnect and retry-on-auth-failure across all SDKs; end-to-end smoke tests against staging gateway; CI run included matrix for py3.9/3.11, Node 16/18, go1.20/1.21. Migration notes: minor surface changes to public constructors for streaming clients (small ergonomic improvements). A migration guide is included in docs/SDK_MIGRATION.md. Backwards compatibility preserved via compatibility shims for one release; recommend updating callers to new retry config shape. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2782) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs & changelog updated - [x] Cross-SDK version bump coordinated - [x] QA smoke tests against staging Related work: Linked Linear items and internal tickets referenced below.

review_conversation: Miguel: Found a race in the TS reconnect flow when socket.close and reconnect both attempt to settle the same promise. Suggested using a connection state guard. Aisha: Addressed by introducing a state machine guard and added unit test to cover reconnect-after-close. Rohit: Python retry policy looks good but suggested making default max_attempts configurable via environment var. Aisha: Added REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_MAX env support and documented behavior in SDK_MIGRATION.md. Liam: Go shim for 401->refresh looks correct; please add a small comment about token refresh backoff. Aisha: Added comment and a lightweight integration test that simulates token expiry. Jocelyn: Approved after CI green and migration docs added.
release_notes: Coordinated SDK release: unify auth/retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go; improved streaming ergonomics and reconnect stability; minor breaking changes for streaming constructors with compatibility shims; version bumps for SDK packages to 2.4.x. See docs/SDK_MIGRATION.md for migration steps.
